objective: Offer a bounded paid acquisition-software implementation using OpenHI evidence, without promising a new ultrasound instrument or requiring the operator to build hardware.

source_need.title: a single-channel pulse-echo A-scan ultrasound
source_need.requested_delivery: Python or MATLAB software to control Digilent Analog Discovery 3 acquisition, save raw ultrasound RF/echo data and display an A-scan waveform.
scope_unknowns: whether a working protected pulser/receiver already feeds the AD3
representative WaveForms trace and trigger timing
one agreed PC/OS and available client-side test access
capture acceptance criteria and client-code/data handling

supported_now: Public Python scientific-camera acquisition, configuration, preview and recording code
Public embedded rotor-control firmware supporting the Embedded Software profile skill
fit.boundary: OpenHI is relevant acquisition-software evidence, not a validated AD3 or ultrasound bench. Hardware validation must run on the client's instrument. No pulser/receiver circuit design, hardware purchase or clinical validation is offered.

application.timestamp_note: The date records submission; confirmed_at is the later full live-proposal readback, not an invented exact click time.
application.schedule_starts_after: Agreed scope, test access and first funded milestone

milestones.description: Agreed capture/configuration test on the client AD3
Python acquisition, raw export and A-scan display
Agreed hardware validation and source handover

application.policy: One ordinary free bid, submitted once. Review scope, client hardware access, AI-assisted handling and funded milestones before accepting work. Keep communication, files and payment on Freelancer. One correction pass for agreed requirements; no ongoing availability commitment or unpaid custom prototype.
